scope: SAME actual signed cone path is a global real isometry exactly when the original angular distance is at least pi; its exact coordinate and positive-radius equator are identified; a supplied fixed-positive-radius cosine-law cone arc is decoded to a SAME-curve angular segment.
source_conventions: Generic cone metric uses min(pi,angular distance), so line criterion is pi<=distance; actual completed directions have diameter<=pi. Positive radius is mandatory for direction recovery; an actual meridian input is not manufactured.
remaining_source_condition: KLP6.20(c) uses a nonempty transverse suspension factor/actual dimension>1. A coarse dimension upper bound n>=2 does not supply this condition.
